sloka: ततः स मथिताष्टाश्वं रथं भग्नाक्षकूबरम् ।विहाय न्यपतद्भूमौ दुर्धरस्त्यक्तजीवितः ।। ५.४६.२६।।।।
transliteration: tataḥ sa mathitāṣṭāśvaṁ rathaṁ bhagnākṣakūbaram ।vihāya nyapatadbhūmau durdharastyaktajīvitaḥ ।। 5.46.26।।।।

translations.english: Having lost his chariot, the horses yoked to it killed, its axle and pole broken to pieces, Durdhara fell down dead from the chariot.
